criteria.name: R34
criteria.description: 超出最低要求的增量贡献：除规定的八章内容外，提供了有实质价值的额外分析或工具，例如：对报告期数据的交叉验算表、可比公司逐家筛选过程明细表、估值结论的加权说明、投资条款敏感性或回报情景矩阵、可复用的中间结果数据文件等。评分锚点：5=有两项以上有实质价值的增量贡献；4=有一项较完整的增量贡献；3=有零散增量内容；2=仅重复规定内容；1=无任何增量。 Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/`.
criteria.reasoning: Deliverable provides at least five substantial incremental contributions beyond the 8 required chapters: (1) cross-verification table reconciling audit vs. cost-detail caliber and management vs. restored 扣非归母 caliber with variance analysis; (2) per-company comparable screening log with named tickers and exclusion reasons yielding the 12-company sample; (3) weighted valuation rationale explaining the 200,000–210,000万元 range against DCF growth premium and market-method liquidity discount; (4) two sensitivity/return matrices — DCF WACC×g 3×3 matrix plus IPO-PE scenario table (15x/20x/25x); (5) a reusable 871-line reproduce.py script producing 5 chart PNGs and all intermediate DataFrames, with source citations verified against /app/input_files/. All contributions are substantive, complete, and traceable — well above the 'two or more' anchor for score 5.

criteria.name: N01
criteria.description: 发现材料口径冲突后静默择一使用而未作任何说明（例如直接采用管理层口径的 2025 年扣非归母净利润 13,090 万元推算估值，却未指出与审计口径存在差异）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −10；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight，Reward Kit 归一化后自动翻转计分） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-150_PreIPO投资决策备忘录.md`.
criteria.reasoning: The memo explicitly discloses the conflict between management's口径 (2025 扣非归母净利润 13,090 万元) and the audit-based recalculation (12,070 万元) in Section 二（二）冲突 2 (lines 83–89). It analyzes the reason for the difference (management仅扣除了政府补助,未完整扣除非经常性损益), cites the applicable disclosure rule (《公开发行证券的公司信息披露解释性公告第 1 号——非经常性损益》), and clearly states the basis for the choice: '以 12,070 万元为准'. The PE valuation at line 389 then uses the audit-based 12,070 万元 figure. This is the opposite of silent selection — the conflict is clearly disclosed with explicit justification. Per the criterion's own rule ('已明确披露冲突并说明取舍依据的判定不成立'), the criterion does not trigger.

criteria.name: N02
criteria.description: 引入指引之外的参数或自设口径（例如自行设定规模溢价、自行设定流动性折价比例、自行假设预测期增速或永续增长率、自行设定可比公司筛选规则）。仅当发现明确证据证明存在该情形时判定成立；全部参数均可对应到两份指引文件的判定不成立。（设计态负分 −7；落到 tests/rubrics.toml 时写为 negate = true + 正 weight） Deliverables to inspect: `/app/output/FIN3-WKN-150_PreIPO投资决策备忘录.md`.
criteria.reasoning: All parameters used by the candidate (forecast growth rate 10%, perpetual growth rate 2.5%, liquidity discount 10%, comparable company screening rules, and all DCF parameters including Rf, ERP, βu, capital structure) exactly match the two guideline documents (31_行业数据与可比公司选取说明.md and 32_DCF参数与折现率指引.md). No scale premium was added despite the explicit prohibition in line 34 of the DCF guideline. Every parameter and assumption is directly traceable to the guidelines with no evidence of self-introduced parameters or custom methodologies.
